My First Wide: Volume 1 (Japanese: My First WIDE: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL ルビーサファイア編 1 My First Wide: Ruby Sapphire Chapter volume 1) is the first volume of an omnibus compilation of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto. It contains chapters originally included in , and .

==Major events==
 
moves from Johto to Littleroot Town in Hoenn.
Ruby arrives at his new house, but quickly runs away.
Ruby meets Professor Birch.
Ruby meets .
Sapphire is revealed to own a Pokédex.
Ruby and Sapphire make a bet to see who can beat their respective goals in eighty days.
Ruby meets .
Ruby helps Wally capture his first Pokémon, a .
Ruby is swept out to sea after an earthquake.
Gabby and Ty are attacked by Team Aqua's .
Sapphire defeats Team Aqua, but they successfully steal the Devon Goods.
Mr. Stone gives Sapphire a letter for .
Ruby is rescued by Mr. Briney at sea.
Ruby meets Steven Stone.
Blaise obtains the Submarine Explorer 1 submarine for Team Magma.
Norman successfully finds Ruby.
Ruby faces his father in battle to force him to let him do Contests. 
Norman allows Ruby to participate in Pokémon Contests.
Shelly and capture Flannery as a way to lure Sapphire.
Sapphire faces Matt in battle to rescue Flannery.
Team Aqua goes to stop Mt. Chimney's activity.

==Gym battles==
defeats Roxanne in PS191.
Sapphire defeats Brawly in PS197.
Sapphire challenges Wattson in PS204 and loses, but he awards her the badge in PS205 for helping him.
